correctness.rationale: For every convex compact K and interior anchor, radial coordinates give A=(1/2) integral rho^2. Conditioned on first point at polar radius r, the small determinant event is a chord strip with area/t→2(rho(theta)+rho(theta+pi))/r, uniformly bounded by 2diam(K)/r. Dominated convergence yields 2H/A² raw slope and 2H/A normalized slope. The exact identity ∫(rho-rho_pi)^2=4A-2I gives 8-J/A, with I>0 and I≤2A. The equality case and sharp lower-bound approach are fully justified by positivity, continuity, and dominated convergence. For six marked variables the exact four-to-one angular change of variables yields conditional densities with pointwise limit 1/(2H) on the radial boxes; normalization and Scheffe establish TV convergence. Local checker passed independent direct simulation and quadrature; finite tests are not a proof.
